thread:
Maya P: quick heads-up — smoke test hit a 404 from the runtime KB while validating the batching guide for the new release. link-checker flagged a shortlink that now returns 404, blocking the e2e doc smoke.
docs-bot: link-checker: detected 1 failing URL: /s/batch-api -> 404 (staging)
Chris L: which page is referencing it? can you paste the failing URL + where it's linked from? I can triage.
Maya P: the page is /kb/runtime/examples (staging). failing shortlink is `/s/batch-api`. quick curl:
```
curl -I https://staging.redwood.ai/s/batch-api
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
```
The shortlink used to redirect to `/kb/runtime/batching-examples` which still exists, so either the shortlink got removed or the redirect rule evaporated during the deploy.
Jorge R: I can pick this up. options: 1) re-add a simple redirect for /s/batch-api -> /kb/runtime/batching-examples (fast) 2) update the page to replace the shortlink with the canonical path (safer long-term). which do we want?
Maya P: prefer redirect for immediate unblock (so release tests pass), but also happy to switch the doc to use the canonical path in a follow-up PR. if you do redirect, please also open a tiny PR/issue to replace the shortlink later.
Jorge R: ok i'll do both: create a redirect in infra-config (fast) + small docs PR to replace the shortlink. sed command I used locally to update the md:
```
# replace shortlink with canonical path in the runtime guide
rg -l "\/s\/batch-api" docs/ | xargs sed -i "s:/s/batch-api:/kb/runtime/batching-examples:g"
```
I'll open the PR as soon as the redirect lands.
Chris L: lgtm — ping me in the PR for review. if you link the PR here I can try to give a quick look before merge.
Priya S: heads-up I'm oncall and largely offline tomorrow morning. if this blocks the release and needs an urgent merge, assign to Chris or tag me after 2pm PT and I'll triage.
Maya P: thanks. Jorge — can you add a one-line changelog in the PR description noting why we removed the shortlink? i'll add it to standup bullets so infra knows to watch the redirect rollout.
Jorge R: yep will do. draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12891 (WIP) — redirect ticket spun up: https://infra.redwood.ai/tickets/2345
docs-bot: auto-flag: created task docs:quick/link-fix, assigned to Jorge R, label "docs:quick".
Maya P: perfect, thanks everyone :tada: will follow up in tomorrow's standup if anything flaps.
